text: Smooth pointed Cheeger-Gromov convergence requires basepoint-preserving diffeomorphisms onto their images from an exhaustion of the limit manifold, such that pullbacks of the actual sequence metrics converge to the limit metric uniformly with all covariant derivatives on compact subsets.

source.title: Lectures on the Ricci Flow
source.author: Peter Topping
source.locator: March9,2006 author-hosted notes, Definition7.1.1, printed p.79 / PDF p.80
source.scope: Complete smooth pointed Riemannian manifolds; convergence data must represent the sequence metrics, not an arbitrarily chosen reference family. The Ricci-flow thick-limit specialization has additional source-specific data, not independently specified here.

scope: PointedModelsConverge_S13 single root only: specialize Topping smooth pointed Cheeger-Gromov convergence to a sequence and limit of the actual finite-volume hyperbolic models. No claim about PointedSmoothConverges_S13, LatePointSequence or thick limits.
